standard_prerequisites.name: Existence of the smallest ideal modulo which the module becomes flat over an Artinian ring
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the ideal whose universal property is proved.

standard_prerequisites.name: Flatness is preserved by base change
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Algebra, Lemma \ref{algebra-lemma-flat-base-change}, cited at proof lines 4039-4040

standard_prerequisites.name: Flatness descends along an injective map of Artinian rings
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Algebra, Lemma \ref{algebra-lemma-descent-flatness-injective-map-artinian-rings}, cited at proof lines 4043-4045
standard_prerequisites.use: Yields flatness of the module modulo the kernel of the base change.

core_obligations: Record existence of the flattening ideal (proof lines 4037-4038).
Derive one implication from base change of flatness (proof lines 4039-4040).
Given a flat base change, form the kernel of the ring map and identify the base change of the module with the base change of the module modulo that kernel (proof lines 4041-4046).
Apply descent of flatness to conclude that the flattening ideal is contained in the kernel (proof lines 4047-4048).
difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes the universal property of the smallest ideal modulo which a module over an Artinian ring becomes flat: a base change makes the module flat exactly when that ideal is killed. Existence of the ideal is quoted from the companion result. One implication is base change of flatness. For the other, the author takes the kernel of the ring map, uses flatness of the base changed module and the identifications along the quotient by that kernel, applies the descent result for injective maps of Artinian rings to conclude that the module modulo the kernel is flat, and therefore that the flattening ideal is contained in the kernel, which is the assertion.
